items.title: File Widerspruch against the refusal of the beach fire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: The letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and was sent by ordinary post. Under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG (the Land's counterpart to § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG) it counts as bekannt gegeben (delivered) on the 4th day after posting: 18.11. + 4 days = Sun 22.11.2026; this deemed-delivery day does not shift for a weekend. The one-month Widerspruch period then starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (23.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day of the period's run, i.e. one month after 22.11.2026 = Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in SH (not a holiday, not a weekend), so no further shift is needed.
